hypothesis: Balancing disconnected components of the original safe80-action lattice at sampled future states preserves underrepresented feasible alternatives and improves complete navigation beyond ordinary sequential safe-action sampling and fixed8 Gaussian MPPI.

sampling.component_graph: Native speed/heading lattice: adjacent speeds at same heading, adjacent cyclic headings at same speed; no output action added.
sampling.uniform: Uniform native actions satisfying the existing predicted endpoint clearance0.2 at each sampled state.
sampling.components: Uniform connected component then uniform action within it. One component is exactly the uniform control with common uniform draws.
sampling.fallback: Empty predicted safe set samples from all native actions; final original hard plan admission rejects unsafe plans. No constraint relaxation.

common: All arms except nominal use the already frozen fixed8 progress-triggered MPPI controller, same native objective/free terminal value, 80 discrete actions, 0.3 smoothing, margin0.2/risk0.8, native50s/dt0.25, legal observations only, no future tapes/goals in the sampler. Both new arms compute graph components and all masks for matching work. No training or4090.
smoke: Six native complete episodes at case121, one duplicate full trace, original80/execution checks, synthetic two-component quota positive control, one-component exact common-draw equality. Component queries must be split in at least two scenes and at least1% of nonterminal sampled-state queries; otherwise KILL as inactive, no full development.

development.scope: Original previously used development cohort, not new confirmation or failure-selected roots.

go: No fewer successes or more contacts/collisions than any control; at least2 more successes than every control OR5% faster paired successful time than strongest control; native component allocation genuinely changes decisions; mean decision below250ms. Fresh confirmation only after all conditions and exact closest-prior contribution review.
kill: Inactive component structure, ordinary safe sampling absorbs gain, task/safety/compute condition fails, or closest prior covers the additional capability. Preserve negatives; no sweeps or rescue.
scope: Action-lattice connected components are not trajectory homotopy classes or safety guarantees. Sampling probabilities are search proposals, not beliefs. No claim of an unbiased continuous-Gaussian MPPI estimator after projection. Independent contribution UNVERIFIED.
